posting.title: Lead Data Scientist
posting.description:
About the role:
Polaris FinTech builds payment-fraud detection systems for Nordic banks and merchants. We are hiring a Lead Data Scientist to own our fraud-detection modeling stack and grow a small data science team.

Responsibilities:
You will design and productionize ML pipelines for fraud and anomaly detection, working closely with engineering. You will set technical direction and mentor two junior data scientists.

Requirements:
5+ years of experience in data science or applied ML, including team leadership experience, is required. Strong hands-on experience with Python (scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas), SQL, AWS, and Spark is required.

Nice to have:
Danish is an advantage but not required — most of the team communicates in English day to day, and all documentation and meetings are in English. Experience with LLMs and prompt engineering is a plus.

Location and work mode:
Hybrid role based in our Copenhagen office, three days a week on-site.

What we offer:
Competitive salary and equity, plus a strong engineering culture.
